postHarvestCuring.method: Pick green; ripen 5–7 d at 65–70 °F or store 30–32 °F

seasonalTasks.title: Harvest pears (pre-tree-ripe)
seasonalTasks.body: Pick when starch test shows ripening but before tree-ripe; finish on bench.

harvestIndicators: Stem releases when fruit lifted + twisted
notes: Susceptible to fire blight (Erwinia amylovora) — DO NOT prune in wet weather; sterilize tools 70% alcohol between cuts.
